choice_data_list: How about going at it head-on with everything you've got...?
Maybe just roll with the upbeat Osaka energy, or……?

Ahahaha☆ Ahahahahaha~★

I don't quite understand what just happened, but
I feel like I've regained a bit of energy……

I reckon I might like takoyaki better, y'know!
